tools.name: bsport_get_api_key_info
tools.description: Show which client, company or franchise the API key uses, its expiry date, and the successful API calls counted per month. Use it to check that the connection works. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/monitoring/me/.

tools.name: bsport_list_clients
tools.description: List clients of the company, with optional filters by id, email or archived state. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/clients/.

tools.name: bsport_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id, with name, contact details, tags and account balance. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/clients/{id}/.

tools.name: bsport_list_client_notes
tools.description: List internal notes, optionally for one client. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/client-notes/.

tools.name: bsport_list_client_class_passes
tools.description: List class passes owned by clients (credits, validity, disabled state), optionally for some clients. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/client-class-passes/.

tools.name: bsport_list_client_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions owned by clients, optionally for one client. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/client-subscriptions/.

tools.name: bsport_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings with filters by client, class, class start window or attendance. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/bookings/.

tools.name: bsport_get_booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id, with its status, class, client pass and attendance. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/bookings/{id}/.

tools.name: bsport_list_classes
tools.description: List classes (sessions) with optional filters by start window, teacher, venue or service. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/classes/.

tools.name: bsport_get_class
tools.description: Get one class by id, with its start time, capacity, bookings, waitlist size and cancellation state. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/classes/{id}/.

tools.name: bsport_get_class_waitlist
tools.description: List the waitlist of one class in position order. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/classes/{id}/waitlist/.

tools.name: bsport_list_appointments
tools.description: List one-to-one appointments with filters by client, teacher, venue or start window. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/appointments/.

tools.name: bsport_list_teachers
tools.description: List teachers (staff who lead classes), optionally only active or disabled ones. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/teachers/.

tools.name: bsport_list_venues
tools.description: List venues (studios, rooms or locations), with optional filters by city or zip code. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/venues/.

tools.name: bsport_list_tags
tools.description: List client tags, optionally for one tag group. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/tags/.

tools.name: bsport_list_tag_groups
tools.description: List tag groups, which hold tags. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/tag-groups/.

tools.name: bsport_list_webhook_registrations
tools.description: List the webhook registrations of the company (the URLs that receive bsport events). Endpoint: GET /api/v2/management/webhook-registrations/.

tools.name: bsport_create_client
tools.description: Create a client record. This stores personal data and sets no marketing consent. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/management/clients/.

tools.name: bsport_create_booking
tools.description: Book one client into one or more classes with a client pass. This uses credits and can notify the client. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/management/bookings/.

tools.name: bsport_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one booking. Choose whether the client is notified and whether the credit is refunded. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/management/bookings/{id}/cancel/.

tools.name: bsport_record_attendance
tools.description: Mark one booking as attended or not attended. Attendance can trigger no-show rules. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/management/bookings/{id}/attendance/.

tools.name: bsport_tag_client
tools.description: Add one tag to one client. Adding a tag that is already set changes nothing. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/management/clients/{id}/tag/.

tools.name: bsport_untag_client
tools.description: Remove one tag from one client. Removing a tag that is not set changes nothing. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/management/clients/{id}/untag/.

tools.name: bsport_create_client_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to one client. Staff can see it, the client cannot. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/management/client-notes/.

tools.name: bsport_create_tag
tools.description: Create a tag in a tag group. The name must be unique within the group. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/management/tags/.

tools.name: bsport_archive_client
tools.description: Archive one client, which hides the client from active lists. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/management/clients/{id}/archive/.

tools.name: bsport_set_client_class_pass_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable one client pass. A disabled pass cannot pay for bookings. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/management/client-class-passes/{id}/enable/ or /disable/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bsport_list_clients, bsport_list_webhook_registrations · Private data: bsport_get_api_key_info, bsport_get_client, bsport_create_client, bsport_record_attendance · Public sink: bsport_list_clients, bsport_list_webhook_registrations, bsport_create_client, bsport_create_booking, bsport_cancel_booking, bsport_record_attendance, bsport_tag_client, bsport_untag_client, bsport_create_client_note, bsport_create_tag, bsport_archive_client, bsport_set_client_class_pass_enabled · Destructive: bsport_untag_client.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bsport_list_clients, bsport_list_webhook_registrations · Private data: bsport_get_api_key_info, bsport_get_client, bsport_create_client, bsport_record_attendance · Public sink: bsport_list_clients, bsport_list_webhook_registrations, bsport_create_client, bsport_create_booking, bsport_cancel_booking, bsport_record_attendance, bsport_tag_client, bsport_untag_client, bsport_create_client_note, bsport_create_tag, bsport_archive_client, bsport_set_client_class_pass_enabled · Destructive: bsport_untag_client

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
